parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one ORIGINAL adult humanoid FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE for a proposed tabletop-game helper, source concept only.
Primary request: Create a single original adult East Asian male mystic support scholar with a stocky, broad and grounded build, short neat dark hair, a calm mature clean-shaven face, and independent facial features. This is a new character design, not a portrait of an actor or reproduction of any movie costume.
Reference roles: The previously viewed Doctor Strange project image informs ONLY the premium sculpted collectible cohort, restrained indigo accent and material readability. Do not copy his face, hairstyle, beard, red cloak, collar, medallions, gloves or costume construction. The previously viewed Medusa quality image informs ONLY crisp sculptural quality, believable anatomy, refined cloth folds and professional studio finish; do not reproduce her character or accessories.
Subject and costume: An unarmed practical support scholar, approximately 45-55 years old. Layered ochre-brown wrap robes with broad solid sculpted folds, elbow-length outer sleeves and fitted brown inner sleeves stopping at the wrists; a broad plain cloth sash with simple fabric fastening, indigo trousers visible as two separate legs below a knee-length split robe, and dark practical cloth-and-leather shoes. Modest original garment construction, subtle warm ochre edging only. No cape, ornate chest emblem, jewelry, magical rings, weapons or props. Bare head, all short hair fully visible; no headgear.
Pose: Relaxed grounded neutral stance, both feet planted parallel facing straight forward, legs slightly apart with charcoal background visibly separating the lower legs. Shoulders level and squared to the viewer. Both upper arms held slightly outward, elbows gently bent about 20-30 degrees, forearms relaxed slightly outward and down. Both empty hands fully visible beside the hips, well separated from sash and robe with clear charcoal gaps; five natural anatomically distinct digits on each hand, relaxed open fingers and visible thumbs, palms angled slightly forward. No clenched fists and no spellcasting gesture. Keep clear background gaps between each arm and the torso.
Composition/framing: Single portrait image, strict FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC elevation. Face, torso, pelvis, knees and shoes all face directly forward; no three-quarter turn, no perspective foreshortening, no tilt, no overhead view. Entire silhouette centered including all hair, hands, shoes and pedestal. Highest point of hair at y=6% of image height, giving 6% clear top margin. Bottom of pedestal exactly at y=90%, leaving 10% plain empty margin below. Generous clear margins at both sides. Full body only, no inset, no extra view.
Pedestal: Exactly ONE round dark stone pedestal made of TWO simple stacked low circular stone discs. Render the pedestal precisely EDGE-ON in this front elevation: only the vertical side bands and a horizontal join line are visible. Flat horizontal upper boundary. ZERO visible top surface, ZERO ellipse and no tilted upper plane. Both feet sit directly on its top boundary. No second separate plinth and no ground plane or surrounding scene.
Style/medium: Highly polished stylized-realistic collectible miniature design render, premium sculptural anatomy and clear large form hierarchy, physically believable matte cloth, subtle woven texture, solid robust robe edges rather than wispy strips, crisp face and hands. Soft neutral studio illumination for readable material colors and folds, restrained shadows, no dramatic rim effects.
Scene/backdrop: Uniform plain charcoal background, no floor, no horizon, no cast shadow on a ground surface.
Constraints: No VFX, particles, aura, magic portals, magical discs, energy rings, smoke, scenery, text, symbols, labels, logos, UI, watermark, actor likeness, franchise key-art copying or copied movie costume. One adult male figure only. Do not borrow the owner's identity or costume wholesale. Keep the specified frontal pose, exact margins, all hands and the edge-on two-disc pedestal.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: correction of the supplied proposed humanoid FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE, source-only.
Edit target: the supplied original scholar image. Preserve the same original mature East Asian male face, stocky body, short dark hair, ochre-brown layered scholar robes, plain cloth sash, indigo trousers, practical shoes, relaxed bent arms, both empty visible hands, clear gaps around the limbs, material finish, front orthographic view, plain charcoal background and one dark two-disc edge-on stone pedestal.
Change ONLY the framing of the entire figure together with its pedestal. The current hair starts around 3% and the base bottom is around 92% of the canvas, which fails the requested framing. Make the complete figure-plus-pedestal slightly smaller and vertically reposition it so that the TOP OF THE HAIR is exactly 6% down from the TOP of the canvas and the BOTTOM OF THE PEDESTAL is exactly 90% down from the TOP. Keep a 10% empty charcoal margin below the base. At a 1024x1536 canvas, these boundaries are approximately y=92 for hair and y=1382 for base bottom. Preserve proportions; no cropping of any part. Keep the subject centered horizontally with both hands and all shoes fully visible. Do not change anatomy, expression, costume, pose or colors.
Invariants: One adult male only, strict straight-on front orthographic view, no perspective rotation or camera tilt. One round stone pedestal made of two stacked discs, precisely edge-on with no visible top ellipse. No ground plane, scenery, props, VFX, portals, magic rings, text, labels, logos or UI. Do not introduce an actor likeness or movie costume. Preserve original design. The only intended correction is the specified top and bottom framing.
